page.layout: One page of text, two lines of running head and page number at top. Main text in one column, with a marginal note in the left margin beside the POLONICA heading. Below the text: the catchword "Ex-" at the lower right.

main_text.p: Regnum Bohemiæ ad exteros pervenit: primò quidem ad Iohannem Ducem Lutzenburgicum, cujus filius fuit Carolo IV Imperator, post quem Wenceslaus ignavus, & deinde Sigismundus regnaverunt. Ab his Bohemia ad domum Austriacam pervenit, quanquam interruptâ successione; quippe Ladislao posthumo repente extinctô Georgius Podjebra-tius, nobilis Bohemus, & deinde Ladislaus & Ludovicus ex Polonis regnarunt. Post has Bohemia denuò ad Austriacos rediit, & semel tantum uno anno ex Palatinis Fridericus regnavit. Quô mox debellatô Austriaci hactenus liberâ electione constituti Bohemiam hæreditarium regnum fecerunt.polo-niæ
main_text.head: POLONICA.
Periodus I.

page.notes: The left margin note "polo / niæ" is set over two lines, with a reference symbol "(ᵗ)" above it; I read the note as a split keyword and mark the division uncertain. The reference mark has no counterpart in the text, so the note is placed at the end of the preceding paragraph. The word "femel" in the print is read as "semel" (long s). The final line ends with a hyphen-like catchword "Ex-", which belongs to the next page. The heading "POLONICA." carries a printed asterisk-like mark, not transcribed.
